summary: Ten NBA Cup games were played, and the home team won seven of them. Jamal Murray scored 39 points in Denver's 127-120 win at Phoenix, and Scottie Barnes scored 41 in Toronto's loss to Orlando. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 31 points, 18 rebounds and 10 assists in Miami's 145-125 win over Indiana, and Golden State came back from 25 down to beat the Lakers 112-95.

games.headline: Wizards pull away in the third to beat Hornets 95-79
games.story: Charlotte led 38-37 midway through the second quarter, but Washington was ahead 51-46 at the half. The Wizards outscored the Hornets 28-13 in the third quarter and led by as many as 25. Anthony Davis had 25 points and 13 rebounds, and Trae Young had 21 points and nine assists. Charlotte shot 30 of 101 from the field, while Washington made 29 of 35 free throws to Charlotte's 7 of 12.

games.headline: Celtics lead by 29 at the half and beat Bulls 125-111
games.story: The score was tied 9-9 early, and Boston led the rest of the way. The Celtics outscored Chicago 44-25 in the first quarter and led 78-49 at halftime, with the lead reaching 32 at its largest. Payton Pritchard scored 30 points and Jayson Tatum added 26. Chicago won the fourth quarter 37-26, and Caleb Wilson had 23 points for the Bulls.

games.headline: Murray scores 39 as Nuggets beat Suns 127-120
games.story: The game had 11 lead changes and seven ties before Denver took the lead for good in the last two minutes of the second quarter. Jamal Murray scored 39 points and Christian Braun had 31 as the Nuggets made 20 of 37 three-pointers. Nikola Jokić added 18 points, 10 assists and seven rebounds. Miles Bridges had 24 points and 10 rebounds for Phoenix.

games.headline: Pistons outscore Nets 71-38 in middle quarters, win 110-94
games.story: Brooklyn led 28-21 after the first quarter, then Detroit took over, outscoring the Nets 35-21 in the second and 36-17 in the third. The game was tied 49-49 with 1:56 left in the half, and Detroit led for the rest of the night, by as many as 30. Cade Cunningham had 20 points and Ronald Holland II added 18. Brooklyn committed 23 turnovers to Detroit's 12 and shot 31 of 77.

games.headline: Irving and Flagg lead Mavericks past Rockets 116-111
games.story: Houston led 51-44 at halftime and by as many as 11, but Dallas outscored the Rockets 40-27 in the fourth quarter. The game was tied 100-100 with 2:26 left, and the Mavericks led from there. Kyrie Irving scored 35 points with nine assists, and Cooper Flagg had 33 points and nine rebounds. Kevin Durant led Houston with 28 points.

games.headline: Giannis posts triple-double as Heat beat Pacers 145-125
games.story: Indiana scored 42 in the first quarter and led 54-53 midway through the second, but Miami led for the rest of the game. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 31 points, 18 rebounds and 10 assists, and Bam Adebayo scored 27. Klay Thompson added 25 points with seven three-pointers. The Heat shot 54 of 93 from the field with 38 assists and led by as many as 25.

games.headline: Timberwolves score 34 in the first and rout Clippers 127-101
games.story: Minnesota trailed 16-15 midway through the first quarter, then scored 34 points in the period to lead by 10 after it. The Timberwolves were ahead 69-56 at the half and led by as many as 29. LaMelo Ball had 24 points and seven assists, and Jaden McDaniels had 23 points on 11-of-15 shooting. Darius Garland scored 24 for the Clippers, who had 17 turnovers to Minnesota's 11. Anthony Edwards did not play for Minnesota.

games.headline: Warriors erase 25-point deficit, beat Lakers 112-95
games.story: Los Angeles scored 38 in the first quarter and led by as many as 25, but Golden State outscored it 38-15 in the second to tie the game 53-53 at the half. The Lakers led 80-79 with 1:16 left in the third quarter, and the Warriors led after that. Stephen Curry scored 31 points with eight three-pointers, and Golden State made 22 of 46 from deep. Luka Dončić scored 37 for Los Angeles, which committed 20 turnovers.

games.headline: 76ers hold off Knicks 98-93 after trailing late
games.story: Philadelphia led 53-44 at halftime and by as many as 14, but New York went ahead 90-89 with 1:32 left in the fourth quarter. The 76ers regained the lead and won 98-93. Tyrese Maxey scored 27 points, Anfernee Simons had 21, and LeBron James had 20 points, nine rebounds and eight assists. Jalen Brunson scored 24 for the Knicks, and Karl-Anthony Towns had 22 points and 12 rebounds.

games.headline: Magic overcome Barnes' 41, beat Raptors 121-114
games.story: Scottie Barnes scored 41 points on 19-of-34 shooting for Toronto, which took a 103-102 lead with 7:17 left in the fourth quarter. Orlando led 64-55 at the half and went back in front for good, finishing 121-114. Desmond Bane scored 28 points and Franz Wagner had 26 points and 11 assists. The Magic made 18 of 34 three-pointers.
